canonical_project: PNG DataCo Caution Bay SEZ Data Centre
notes: PNG DataCo CEO Paul Komboi (Business Advantage PNG interview, 2026-02-05) states DataCo plans to build another data centre at Kumul Petroleum's special economic zone in Caution Bay (Central Province, near Port Moresby); Tech In Pacific repeats the plan. No construction start, tender, permit or capacity published; recorded as planned (announced) per methodology. Caution Bay is in Central Province, outside NCD.
